song.name: Mystic Horizon
song.plot: Anya reaches the Celestial Gardens on Auroria's edge, where Elara, Keeper of Starlight, reveals her truth: she is a Void-Echo, born of Eclipse, a paradox of light immune to the Void — the Living Lock who must seal Nyktoros.
song.analysis: Full-structure restore of the kept song: every original section (Verse 1, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Verse 2, Pre-Chorus, Chorus, Bridge, Chorus, Outro) preserved in order, line-by-line syllable counts matched, ≥70% verbatim. KEY CANON FIX (design spec): the prophecy is The Void-Echo, never "Impossible Key". Verse 2 now carries Elara's reveal — "She's the Void-Echo, born of Eclipse, a paradox of light", set against "the eternal Void" she stands pure before. Suggested Suno direction: ethereal resolve — glass-bells, celestial choir, a horizon opening into light before the dark truth settles.

section.name: Verse 1
section.original: Beyond the veil of twilight, where the mystic rivers flow, Lies a land of ancient secrets, where the starlit wonders glow. Through the mists of time we wander, seeking truths long left behind, In the heart of endless dreaming, where the cosmic forces bind.

section.name: Pre-Chorus
section.original: In the realms of the forgotten, where legends come to life, We chase the distant echoes, through the shadows and the strife.

section.name: Chorus
section.original: To the Mystic Horizons, where the magic meets the sea, We’ll sail on winds of destiny, to where our spirits free. In the land of endless wonder, where our dreams ignite the skies, Through the Mystic Horizons, we’ll find our paradise.

section.name: Verse 2
section.original: In the cradle of the mountains, where the ancient spirits sing, We’ll uncover hidden answers, in the whispers of the wind. With the courage of the fearless, and the wisdom of the old, We journey through the stardust, to the tales that must be told.
section.reworked: In the presence of Elara, where the ancient spirits sing, She reveals the hidden answers that the twilight winds will bring. Yet pure before the eternal Void, within the holy night, She's the Void-Echo, born of Eclipse, a paradox of light.

section.name: Bridge
section.original: As the night unveils its secrets, and the stars begin to fade, We’ll stand upon the edge of time, where destinies are made. In the dance of cosmic forces, our hearts will find their way, Through the Mystic Horizons, to a brighter day.

section.name: Outro
section.original: When the final dawn approaches, and the journey meets its end, We’ll look back on the horizons, where the stars and dreams ascend. For in the Mystic Horizons, our hearts and souls will blend, Eternal in the cosmos, where our spirits transcend.
